translation.name: A Ch'an Biblia D'a Chuj San Mateo

content: Aloj vach' lolonel yuj tas sb'onac Dios

content.text: D'a val smasanil in c'ool ol val vach' lolonel d'a Jehová.
Yacb'an pitzan into ol val vach' lolonel d'ay. Yacb'an ayinto eq'ui, ol in b'itan d'a in Diosal.
Man̈ eyac'och anima nivan yelc'och yipoc e c'ool, yujto animan̈ej eb', yuj chi' max yal-laj scolvaj eb'.
Ayic scham eb', tz'ochcan eb' pococal. A d'a jun c'u chi' slajvicanel tastac sna eb' sc'ulej.
Te vach' yic mach schaan scolval sDiosal vin̈aj Jacob. An̈ej Jehová Dios chi' ayoch yipoc sc'ool.
A Jehová b'oannac satchaan̈, lum luum, a' mar yed' masanil tastac ay d'a junjun macan̈ chi'. Tz'eln̈ejc'och tas syala'.
A' sb'oan yaj b'aj tz'ixtaj eb' anima, syac'anpax svael eb' ay svejel. A' scolanel eb' ayoch d'a preso.
A Jehová sjacan sat eb' max ujilaj yilani, squetzan q'ue vaan eb' stelvi. Xajan eb' anima vach' spensar yuuj.
A Jehová scolan eb' anima ch'oc chon̈ab'il. An̈ejton pax a' tz'ilan eb' unin chamnac smam yed' eb' ix ix chamnac yetb'eyum. Palta tz'ac'ji somchaj eb' sc'ulan chucal yuuj.
Ex aj Sion, a Jehová ol ac'an Yajalil d'a masanil tiempo. A co Diosal ol och Reyal d'a juneln̈ej.
